a: e ≈ 2.71828 is the base of natural logarithms.
π ≈ 3.14159 is the ratio of circumference to diameter.
|x| is x if x ≥ 0 and -x if x < 0.
Multiplying/dividing an inequality by a negative flips the sign.
Parallel lines never meet and have equal slopes in a plane.
Perpendicular lines have slopes whose product is -1 (if defined).
Angles in a triangle sum to 180 degrees.
